verses.pali: “Dvāhaṁ, bhikkhave, atthavase sampassamāno araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevāmi.
verses.english: “Mendicants, I see two reasons to frequent remote lodgings in the wilderness and the forest.

verses.pali: Attano ca diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāraṁ sampassamāno, pacchimañca janataṁ anukampamāno.
verses.english: Seeing happiness for oneself in this life, and having sympathy for future generations.

verses.pali: Ime kho ahaṁ, bhikkhave, dve atthavase sampassamāno araññavanapatthāni pantāni senāsanāni paṭisevāmī”ti.
verses.english: I see two reasons to frequent remote lodgings in the wilderness and the forest.”
